race.comment: JARRITO (12) sharp sprinting mare building an imposing record. Appreciated the firmer track third-up when she ran slick time to score by 2.75 lens at Warwick Farm over this trip in BM72 grade. Finds a lot more pressure today and looks ready for this grade. POLYGLOT (5) indicated he was back to his best when saving ground along the inside to get the better of Columbia Blue as fav over 1100m at this track four weeks ago. That form has since been franked and expect another big run. COUPLES RETREAT (11) unlucky two-back over the 1200m here, then anchored with the 58.5kg when a gritty fourth over 1200m at this track on the heavy (9) surface. Back to her right trip and the winkers go on. Looks the value play. ZOURIPPER (10) drops in grade on the backup after running a slashing third to Hawker Hall over this trip at Randwick last Saturday. Key jockey change and look for him late. HUON (7) good winner first-up and don't dismiss from the draw with Fitzgerald's 3kg claim. One for the exotics.
